name: Rustle · Gremlet #8
description:
A red panda with a striped autumn tail. Stands up tall to look bigger when surprised.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Rustle in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
